epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase successful local deployments from 0% to >99%
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack containerization
R2: Expose health-check endpoint for verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose file and health check, so that local verification is possible.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local environment without Docker setup, When a user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack containers start successfully.
Given a running full stack, When a health-check request is made, Then a success status is returned.
Given the implementation slice, When QA verifies the setup, Then tests confirm correct startup and observability.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce invalid protocol entries from >5% to <1%
requirements: R1: Implement UI action to update existing materials via PUT
R2: Implement UI action to delete materials via DELETE

slices.title: Add UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the catalog UI for this epic, I want to connect update and delete actions to the API, so that the knowledge base remains accurate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When the user updates it in the UI, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint and updates the view.
Given an outdated material, When the user clicks delete, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the view.
Given the implementation slice, When QA verifies the changes, Then tests confirm the update and delete functionality works end-to-end.
slices.tocConstraintRef: UI actions for PUT and DELETE missing
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to update or delete material from >5 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When a researcher opens the platform, I want to enforce secure login controls, so that sensitive medical data cannot be viewed or altered by public users.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication blocking and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated requests and prompt for login, so that restricted data is protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted catalog endpoints, Then they are blocked with a 401 response.
Given an unauthenticated user on the UI, When they are blocked, Then they are prompted to log in.
Given the implementation slice, When QA verifies the security, Then integration tests confirm unauthorized users cannot access restricted resources.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase unauthorized request rejection rate from 0% to 100%
